structured.answer: I didn't decide. My employer would put in ₪2,250 a month and I'd put in ₪750, which sounds good, but a red "−64,761" and the words "מסלול מדד S&P500" (sounds like shares, not a deposit) scared me, so I'll ask my son or the bank clerk before I sign anything.

Five bars: 45,000, +135,000, +21,218, −64,761 in red, then 136,457. I don't add numbers and couldn't tell what the end figure means. The red minus made me back away.
